---
title: Risotto with Shrimp
id: MAR-0100
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 45
difficulty: medium
---
## Ingredients
- 280 g rice
- 400 g shrimp
- 1 garlic clove
- 1 tablespoon parsley
- 20 g butter
- 30 g sour butter
- to taste salt
## Method
1. Wash the shrimp and boil them for 5 minutes in a liter of salted water.
2. Drain them, filter the water and bring it to a boil.
3. Shell the shrimp, remove the carapace and intestinal vein.
4. Peel the garlic, let it wilt in a pan with 10 g of butter, after 4 minutes remove it, add the shrimp with the parsley, stir and turn off the heat.
5. Melt the remaining butter in a saucepan and toast the rice for just over a minute.
6. Pour a ladle of the shrimp water, stir, gradually add more broth, keeping the rice constantly half-submerged, until cooked; once ready, turn off the heat and add the sour butter and the shrimp, stir and serve.
